subject: Logic 13 track-header Volume fader: an AXIncrement, AXDecrement or AXValue write is readable at once, so the time of mixer.set_volume was fixed sleeps and the header walk
question: On Logic 13 how long after an Accessibility write on a track-header Volume fader does its AXValue read the new value, and what part of a mixer.set_volume call is the header walk?

reverify.command: On a disposable copy of a five-track project in Logic 13, start one LogicProMCP server and call logic_mixer set_volume 20 times on the same track with values 0.72 and 0.45 alternating, timing each call from the client, then read the track's header fader with a separate Accessibility reader.
reverify.expected: Every call returns State A with verified true and reached_exact true; the median call is under 20 ms after the first; the first call and any call after the rail changed show locate_path full_walk; the reader shows the last requested value.
reverify.cost: A disposable project copy; about 2 minutes; no save.

method: Built main at 9664b4f1 and called logic_mixer set_volume 20 times on track index 2 of a copy of the R11 fixture in one server process, timing each call; repeated the run with temporary timers in the write path to split locate, nudge and fine phases. Built the repair and made the same 20 calls, then 1 call, 3 calls after selecting another track, 3 after two blind Mixer toggles, 3 after selecting track 0, and one repeat of the last value 2 s later. Every call's envelope was recorded.

observations.what: before, split of one call, ms
fixed sleep before each readback in the unrepaired write loop, ms
observations.reads_after_the_repair: the first read after each write already returned the new value in the 13 steps of a call

observations.what: after two blind Mixer toggles, 3 calls each side, and after selecting track 0, 3 calls
same value requested 2 s after the last write

conclusion: On this host the header Volume fader reads its new AXValue immediately after each write; the fixed 25 ms sleep before every readback was the larger part of a call, and the whole-window header walk was 70 to 95 ms. Polling from the first read and reusing a revalidated fader took the median from 530 ms to 6.2 ms with the same State A, step counts and final raw values, and the value held 2 s later.
limits: One Logic 13.0 build 7801 host, ko-KR, one fixture, one track, header Volume fader only; pan, Mixer-strip writes and other operations were not measured.
The per-part split of a before-call comes from temporary timers and is not committed.
Whether the Mixer panel changed visibility during the blind toggles was not observed; the rail does not depend on it.
A reordered rail or a changed slider falling back to the full locate is covered by unit tests, not measured live.
The evidence files are retained under the author's cache and are not committed.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This record measures call latency and write readback timing. It adds no Apple label vocabulary and claims no string-corpus value.
